why: Avoid repeated Auth/profile/audit creation; preserve same identity across restart/readback/progress tests
constraint: Existing attempts key and max_attempts/completion aggregate by tenant+actor+activity; scenarioId alone cannot reset or isolate historical COMPLETED
policy: One active scope per actor/activity. Within a scenario preserve rows across restart. Between independent from-empty scenarios, require separately approved exact test-owned attempt/progress cleanup and read-only baseline check, OR retain completed history and run readback-only cases. Never manufacture INCOMPLETE via registry and never filter authoritative completion by arbitrary new run IDs.
cleanup: Only recorded test subject+tenant+activity/version rows, after dependency check; no CASCADE and no canonical node/activity/secret deletion
retention: Safe external evidence retained; identity reused disabled outside scopes; cleanup is not implicitly approved
